records.command:
rg -n 'context.*cancel' crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_duplicate.rs | head
sed -n '20,32p' crates/editor-api/src/classic.rs
rg -n 'async.*save|project.settings' classic/apps/web/src/core/managers/project-manager.ts | tail -12
rg -n 'active.settings' classic/apps/web/src/core/managers/renderer-manager.ts

python3 - <<'PY'
p='crates/editor-api/src/operations.rs'
s=open(p).read().replace('mod classic_scenes;','mod classic_scenes;\npub(crate) mod classic_automation;').replace('    classic_scenes::register_classic_scene_operations(registry, state.clone(), events.clone())?;','    classic_scenes::register_classic_scene_operations(registry, state.clone(), events.clone())?;\n    classic_automation::register_classic_automation(registry, state.clone(), events.clone())?;');open(p,'w').write(s)
p='crates/editor-api/src/classic.rs';s=open(p).read().replace('        self.name()?;\n        self.settings()?;','        self.name()?;\n        self.settings()?;\n        crate::operations::classic_automation::validate(self.document.get("automationEdits")).map_err(|e| invalid(&e))?;').replace('        for scene in scenes {','        for scene in scenes {\n            if let Some(settings)=scene.get("settings") { crate::operations::classic_settings::validate_settings(settings).map_err(|e| invalid(&e))?; }',1);open(p,'w').write(s)
p='crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_automation.rs';s=open(p).read().replace('                    context.check_cancelled()?;','                    context.cancellation.check()?;');open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
cargo check -q -p opencut-editor-api

rg -n 'context.*cancel' crates/editor-api/src/operations/classic_duplicate.rs | head
sed -n '20,32p' crates/editor-api/src/classic.rs
rg -n 'async.*save|project.settings' classic/apps/web/src/core/managers/project-manager.ts | tail -12
rg -n 'active.settings' classic/apps/web/src/core/managers/renderer-manager.ts
